name: storyforge
description: Claude Code plugins that turn specs into epics and stories, then implement a story on a local branch with test-first work and blind verification.

plugins.name: break-down
plugins.description: Break a specification into epics, then into implementation-ready stories, without dropping or inventing requirements.

plugins.name: implement-story
plugins.description: Take one story-sized task from description to a reviewed, verified local branch: plan, implement test-first, check, and verify blind with independent reviewers.
